# Osama Omari

> Software engineer and Flutter developer from Jordan. 4 years of experience building scalable cross-platform mobile apps with Flutter and APIs with NestJS. Led a team and mentored junior developers at Code-mint (Jul 2022 – Jun 2025). 1st place, Best Mobile Application among Jordanian universities (2022).
